verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is GPU hardware; its 'UI' (AMD Software control panel) governs gaming/driver features (Anti-Lag, FSR, HYPR-RX) while AI workloads are accessed purely through ROCm/PyTorch APIs with no comparable graphical AI interface. There is no product surface where UI and API offer parallel AI-native capabilities, so this API/UI parity story is a category mismatch for a GPU product rather than a gap in delivery.
